# orion media

Media on the canvas

```sh
orion media <command> [options]
```

## orion media insert

Insert a media node from a file

```sh
orion media insert [file] [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                                    |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `[file]`          | Media file (PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP supported) |
| `--label <value>` | Node label                                     |
| `--group <value>` | Group to put the node in                       |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                                     |

## orion media list

List media nodes

```sh
orion media list [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |
